title: Hot-apply running network worker settings
summary: Implement B1 from the network worker hardening plan by applying saved worker URL, token, and path-map changes to a running worker dispatcher without requiring Stop/Start.
reason: WorkerCoordinatorUrl changes previously took effect only after restart, leaving a stale worker pointed at the wrong coordinator after settings were saved.
behavior_before: Saving distributed worker settings updated persisted config but a running worker dispatcher could keep polling with stale coordinator URL/path-map/auth state until restarted.
behavior_after: Saving WorkerCoordinatorUrl, WorkerAuthToken, or WorkerSourcePathMap will update the live worker dispatcher when it is running and wake the poll loop for the next claim attempt.
